scope: All 113 units read (Pōtana, Bhāgavatam 10.1.1680–1792): translation and word glosses against the Telugu text. The Telugu was not compared with the TTD print. The closing colophon (unit 113) is translated in summary, its word gloss in full. The two doubt-marker flags (units 47, 78) are the word “broken” in the story.

items.issue: కలువడములు are festoons (hung with the arches); it had been taken as కలువ + దండ, “garlands of lilies”.
చిక్కని is “stout, firm”; it was rendered “who cannot be caught”.
items.change: Now “like some stout, true warrior”; word gloss likewise.

items.issue: The verse says that the dharma Brahmā gave kings is itself that brother kills brother for a kingdom (Bhāgavata 10.54.40). The translation inserted “yet”, making the killing a breach of that dharma.
